analyst_view.overall: Milan confirmed on Saturday that Strahinja Pavlovic will miss the trip, so Ruben Amorim is without Pavlovic, Tomori and Gabbia at centre-back. Reports expect Sankhoun Diawara to move into the middle, with Estupiñan or Bartesaghi at left-back. Milan come off a 2-0 Europa League defeat to Ferencvaros, after which Amorim said 'we failed', while Daniele De Rossi's Genoa have won four of their last five and have no injuries. Maignan returns in goal from a European suspension.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. Milan will play with a makeshift back line, with Diawara at centre-back and no Pavlovic, Tomori or Gabbia, against a Genoa side that has won four of five. Amorim will also want a strong reaction after the Ferencvaros defeat, so we expect a slightly more open game than the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Milan should have more of the ball, while De Rossi's 3-4-2-1 will look to break through Messias and El Shaarawy. That fits the model's even split, and nothing in the news moves it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards, which is already high because of referee Davide Massa's record and Genoa's home games. A tense Milan side could add a booking, but the model already expects a lively, physical game.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.6 shots. Pulisic, Modric, Rabiot and Ramos are all expected to start for a Milan side under pressure to respond. Genoa have been creating chances in their winning run and should find space against Milan's patched-up defence.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target. A full-strength Milan front line and an in-form Genoa attack facing a back line built around Diawara both point to a few more efforts on target than usual.
